title: New-feature dots come back a year later on the same date
what: The What's new list stores each version's date as a day and month with no year. The dot logic reads that date as this year whenever the day has come, so on the same date a year later every feature the member never opened counts as brand new again, is put first, and lights its dots for 30 more days. No test checks a year later.
expected: A feature lights its dots only in the 30 days after it really came out; a year-old feature never lights again.
how_often: every year on the anniversary of each feature
fix_line: Give each What's new date its year, or stop dots for anything older than the installed version's window, and add a year-later test

title: The crash screen says "Your workout is safe" even while saving is failing
what: When a screen crashes, the message always says the workout is safe. It never checks whether the save-problem banner is up, so a member whose phone cannot save (full storage, a failed Finish) is told the workout is safe at the same moment. No test covers this case.
expected: While saving is failing, the crash screen does not promise that the workout is safe.
how_often: only when a screen crashes while saves are failing
fix_line: Show the safe line only when no save problem is waiting, and test both cases

title: No test checks the crash screen's Go back and Go to Workout, or a crash of the whole app frame
what: The one crash-screen test mocks the buttons away, so nothing checks that Go back and Go to Workout appear and work, that a screen that crashes every time can be left, or that a crash of the app frame shows only Try again. A broken way out would ship unseen.
expected: A test drives a crashing screen: Go back returns to the screen before, Go to Workout opens the Workout tab, and a frame crash shows only Try again.
fix_line: Add a test that crashes a screen on purpose and presses each button

title: The "Backups now go to your MettleUp account" card is never shown or tapped in any test
what: Tests check only the card's rule and words. No test puts a phone in the Drive-linked state and checks that the card shows, that Sign in opens Backup and restore, or that Got it closes it at once and for good; the phone test says this is left to a check on his phone.
expected: A phone test with Drive linked sees the card, taps Sign in and Got it, and sees it gone after a restart.
how_often: until the card is removed (about Feb 2027)
fix_line: Add a test-build switch that marks Drive as linked and drive the card in the phone tests

title: No test moves a member from one branded gym to another
what: Every branding test starts from no gym or an unbranded gym. Nothing checks that after leaving branded gym A and joining branded gym B, gym A's logo or name never flashes, or that a saved logo of gym A is not used for gym B.
expected: A test leaves one branded gym, joins another, and checks only the second gym's name and logo appear.
fix_line: Add a gym A to gym B case to the theme test

title: The Gym tab's bigger header is tested as different, but the journey says it must match the other tabs
what: Since the owner asked for a bigger logo and name on the Gym tab, the test checks that the Gym tab header is bigger than the small mark on Workout and Profile. The journey still says the Gym tab must not show a mark that differs from the other two tabs.
expected: The journey and the test agree: the same gym logo and name on all three tabs, bigger on the Gym tab.
fix_line: Update the journey line to say the same gym, bigger on the Gym tab

title: A failed "Save changes" on a past workout, and a Finish failing together with autosave, are never tested
what: Tests cover a failed Finish, but nothing checks the "Couldn't save your changes" line when editing a past workout fails, that the edit screen stays open, or that a failing autosave after a failed Finish keeps the Finish line on top.
expected: A test makes the edit save fail and checks the line and that the edit stays open; another makes both Finish and autosave fail and checks only the Finish line shows.
fix_line: Add the two cases next to the failed Finish tests
